name: well-used-gemini
description: Runs Gemini behind runtime-checked gates (se_new agentic pipeline) and checks Gemini CLI's own answers for fabricated status/version claims.

settings.name: Gemini API Key
settings.description: Key the agentic pipeline uses to call gemini-3.1-flash-lite (stored in the system keychain).

settings.name: GitHub Token
settings.description: Optional. Read-only token for cogito5170 repositories (private repos and code search). Leave empty for public repos only. Stored in the system keychain.
